svg.text: ONE BLOCK: A, B, C, JOINED AND SPLIT
Blocks at almost twice the face's size, in the new palette. SPLIT turns a STEREO jack into L over R; JOIN back.
One lightness, one chroma, hues spread round the circle: none shouts, each is told apart, the cream lettering reads on all.
a copy of what an output plays
NOW: an app's INPUT (ochre) and OUTPUT (rust) are 42° apart and look alike; VIDEO shares INPUT's colour. NEW: INPUT green, OUTPUT rust, each its own hue.
The band half the input's colour, half the output's; the name once across it.
B · ONE BAND, IN AND OUT BELOW
A warm grey band with the name; IN and OUT tags by their jacks, in their colours.
C · AS A PEDAL, ONE SPLIT
IN at the left edge, OUT at the right, an arrow between; one SPLIT splits both sides.
C2 · AS A PEDAL, A SPLIT EACH SIDE
C's shape, each side splitting on its own.
